name: comp-154
title: Disabled Radio Group
blurb: Disabled radio group where no options can be selected.
description: Radio group with disabled attribute applied to the entire group. All options are unselectable. Option 2 would be pre-selected if not disabled.
avoid_when: Hidden fields—use disabled to prevent confusion.
a11y: RadioGroup disabled status propagates to all items. Screen readers announce disabled state. Keyboard focus still possible but no change allowed.
